objective: Feed valid existing cached JDs into unchanged eligibility filtering, preserving all collector fields and default production behavior.
allowed_changes: Canary-only feature flag enables read-only JD cache hydration before existing eligibility filtering in both search endpoints
Retain all collector metadata and valid original descriptions, failing back if the cache is unavailable
Add before/after regression tests with no new services, database tables, provider calls or dependencies
forbidden_changes: automatic CV generation absent user click
ranking, local or AI scoring engines, model providers and score thresholds
CV generation, templates, profile facts and résumé scoring
changes to eligibility criteria, ranker, scoring or CV behavior; production flag must remain off by default
acceptance: Canary optionally supplies existing cached JD text before the current filter
Previously valid collector data, filter rules, scoring and CV stay unchanged
Cache failures preserve original filter inputs without crashing searches
Before/after regressions pass and canary verification is documented, without merge to main
deployment: Scope contract update must be committed separately from implementation for the immutable-contract gate check; canary validation before production, main requires explicit permission.
